body_lead: BHUBANESWAR: Artificial intelligence (AI) will soon assist government departments in drafting responses to judicial petitions in a time-bound manner and deal with the issue of pendency more efficiently. The Odisha Computer Application Centre has been tasked to develop an ‘AI-based judicial petition response drafting system’ for the purpose.
